label: Diagram 2.6
caption: Diagram 2.6 Wall type 1 – bonded junction – masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall with solid separating wall
description: The image shows two diagrams side by side. The left, headed 'Diagram 2.6 Wall type 1 – bonded junction – masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall with solid separating wall', is an isometric line drawing of a masonry corner. Two courses of bricks or blocks meet at a right angle, illustrating the bonded junction between the masonry inner leaf and the solid separating wall; no dimensions appear. The right diagram, headed 'Diagram 2.8 Wall type 1 – position of openings in masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall', is a perspective view of a wall corner with a rectangular opening drawn in its face. A label 'Separating wall' is placed on the left wall, and 'Masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall' sits below the rectangle. Two dimensions are marked: x, the horizontal distance from the corner to the left edge of the opening, and y, the vertical height of the opening. Text above reads 'x not more than 700mm and y not less than 1m'. Beneath the right diagram, a heading reads 'Junctions with an external cavity wall with timber frame inner leaf', followed by cut-off running text beginning '2.19 Where the external wall is a cavity wall'.
